bound_facts: Provincial/city VPP service centers own operator and aggregated-user archive review, aggregation-relationship establishment, system-data access, capability-test applications, baseline calculation, monitoring, evaluation and technical support.

The power trading institution owns VPP/aggregated-user registration, aggregation-contract signing, transaction declarations, information disclosure, credit evaluation, transaction organization and settlement basis.
VPP operators own self-built technical support systems, resource mining, user aggregation, capability evaluation and market participation.
Operators must offer different flexible-adjustment retail packages and agree benefit-sharing mechanisms.
System-platform and smart-metering service providers are explicitly supported for aggregation-platform construction and collection-device installation.
The province requires persistent flexible-resource surveys and structured response-resource libraries.
The 2026-04 revised Shandong power-market rules are the current governing market rule set.
Current market design directs VPPs to aggregate distributed renewable and user-side adjustment resources that cannot independently enter the market.

contradiction_search: Official policy supports third-party platform and metering service providers, so technology-service participation is not prohibited.
No current official evidence in this bounded preflight establishes an independent neutral cross-operator router with authority over aggregation relationships, registration, contracting or settlement.
No current official evidence in this bounded preflight establishes scalable permissioned cross-operator resource/offer data access for a small independent router.
unresolved_but_not_promotable: Private commercial data-sharing arrangements may exist outside public evidence.
A comparison/advisory product can be imagined, but current evidence does not establish that it owns a recurring missing edge rather than sitting on incumbent control surfaces.
